# cloudl

Website adapters, browser automation and media downloads from the command line.
Repository: https://github.com/jyjyxt/cloudownloader
Website: https://cloudownloader.com/

## Install from source

Requires Node.js >= 20.18.1.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/jyjyxt/cloudownloader.git
cd cloudownloader
npm install
npm link
cloudl --help
```

For browser commands, download cloudownloader-extension-v{version}.zip from
https://github.com/jyjyxt/cloudownloader/releases, unzip it, enable Developer mode
at chrome://extensions and choose Load unpacked. Run `cloudl doctor` to check
the connection. Log into the target website in Chrome when required.

## Commands

- `cloudl list`: inspect registered adapters.
- `cloudl <site> <command> --help`: inspect arguments for an adapter.
- `cloudl browser work open https://example.com`: open a browser session.
- `cloudl browser work state`: inspect the page.
- `cloudl browser work close`: release the session.
- `cloudl plugin list`: list installed plugins.

Browser commands require a session name immediately after `browser`.
Adapter availability depends on the target website, login state and local dependencies.

## AI skills and compatibility

Install bundled skills with `npx skills add jyjyxt/cloudownloader`.
The executable is `cloudl`. This project derives from OpenCLI and retains the
actual `opencli-*` skill identifiers, `~/.opencli` configuration directory,
`OPENCLI_*` environment variables and `@jackwener/opencli` package imports.
